6.242 rsInvalidFixedDataRowPosition
Applies to RDL 2008/01, RDL 2010/01, and RDL 2016/01
rsInvalidFixedDataRowPosition is a critical error that will occur when TablixMember.FixedData is set to
true for a non-first TablixMember within a TablixRowHierarchy.
